answer: A Dedicated device bound by attestation certificate with a public binding record ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and a public binding record keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A sonnet that appears twice is the tell: the same channel cannot back two identities. From the plume to the mesa, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
